querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      volume_ratio_5d,
                                      vam_1m,
                                      vam_5m,
                                      vam_22m,
                                      vam_60m,
                                      ama_1w,
                                      ama_1m,
                                      ama_1q,
                                      vmacd,
                                      vmacd_dea,
                                      vmacd_macd,
                                      vosc,
                                      tapi_16d,
                                      tapi_6d,
                                      vstd_10d,
                                      vmacd_ema12d,
                                      vmacd_ema26d,
                                      vrsi_6d,
                                      vroc_12d,
                                      sobv,
                                      vr_26d,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_asharetechindicators.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.asharetechindicators WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
